prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a burst pipe in winter. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a pipe bursts during cold weather, you should take immediate steps to stop the flow of water and protect the home from further damage.
